mutations.name: a deploy-pause-clear deposit gets no console tap
kills: a deposit's typed op becomes an owner-op tap for a deploy-pause-clear

mutations.name: a factory-config-set deposit gets a console tap before its effect lands
kills: a deposit's typed op stays on the terminal for a kind with no console tap yet

mutations.name: the sent-back allowlist lacks waive-proof
kills: actionFor taps a waivable sh-sent-back gate with await-new-head and offers waive-proof as its second tap, never abandon

mutations.name: an item with no options is offered every decision
kills: actionFor offers no waiver on a sent-back gate whose item lists no options, leaving that check to the factory

mutations.name: a second tap is offered where the gate lacks the item's own
kills: actionFor keeps an sh-sent-back gate whose options lack await-new-head on the terminal
